Serious cardiopulmonary reactions, including fatalities, have been reported with perflutren and it should be used with extreme caution in patients with pulmonary hypertension or unstable car- diopulmonary conditions. The safety of perflutren has not been established in patients with right-to-left cardiac shunts; it should also be used with extreme caution or avoided in such patients. Perflutren has also been given by intra-ocular injection to pro- vide tamponade in the management of retinal detachment. Adverse effects. References. 1. Herzog CA.
